_help.version: version is the game version and build counts the test copies of that version (start build at 1 for each new version, count up for each test copy). Both only need changing here.
_help.era: era only goes up if the version numbers are ever reset lower (they were once, 23 Nov 2026: 0.3.8 became 0.1.0), so games from before still get moved on to the newest version.
_help.server: server is the address of the online world. The test link and the release both join the same live world (there's no separate test world). Leave it empty to play offline.
_help.devlog: What's new, shown in the Menu. Newest first, one entry per version: version, date (the release day, with from for a range), no name (Luke, 26 Nov 2026: versions only), and short lines for players in added (+ new features), improved (~ changes to what's there) and fixed (− bug fixes and removed issues). No full stop at the end.

added: While placing, circles show where people sit round a campfire and the front of a crate
improved: A crate faces you when you place it, and your person stands at its front to use it

added: Faint squares show on the ground while you choose where to place or dig
Planks: split a log with a stone axe on the craft mat
Small wooden crate: 5 squares to keep things in at your camp
improved: Campfires and farm fields go on 1 metre squares, so things line up easily
Farm fields are 1 metre (were 1.5), and ones already dug moved onto the new squares
Your inventory has 10 squares, with up to 10 of a thing in each (tools and campfires 1)
fixed: Left by the fire while you're away, your person gets up to sleep, drink and eat

improved: A big rebuild behind the scenes, to get the game ready for everything coming next
Problems in the game are reported in more detail, so they're quicker to fix

added: Craft mat and Recipes: every recipe under headings, simple to advanced. Tap one, then Make
Tools made in steps: sharp stones, tool handles, then stone heads for each tool
A tool bar with 7 spots above your inventory, and tools on it weigh nothing
Farming: dig fields in your camp with a stone hoe and grow berry bushes from seeds
Cooked fish: catch raw fish at the pond and cook it at a lit campfire
Camps: light your first campfire to start one, then invite people nearby to share it
Your person carries on with your task list while you're away
Drag things around the world and out of your inventory to where they should go
Play on other devices: link your phone and computer with a code
Leave the world for good, in Settings
A loading screen, an app icon, tips for your first steps, and Privacy and rules
improved: Your person stays in the world for 7 days while you're away, and fires hold 7 days of fuel
Campfires snap to a half-metre grid and turn 4 ways, on levelled ground
Quicker grass cutting, mining and cooking, and trees and boulders grow back in 1 to 2 days
More stones and tall grass around the world
Clearer wording all over, and tap menus match the task list
Names are one of a kind
Things left on the ground fade after 7 days, unless they're in a camp
Making your person fits a phone held sideways
A quicker first load, and a main menu that's easier on your battery
fixed: Sleep: you stay lying down, and drop asleep when Rest runs out
Tools are held in the right hand, and feet no longer sink into slopes
Rocks, trees and bushes stay put next to campfires and farm fields
The chat Send button no longer slips off small phones
The feedback box no longer zooms the page in on iPhones
Tapping something another player had just picked up no longer causes an error

added: First playable: berry bushes, tap menus, the task list and the pause menu
One shared online world, with speech bubbles, a chat filter, Mute and Report
Your person stays in the world and looks after themselves while you're away
Rest and Stamina, sleeping, and one Darwin clock for everyone
Crafting and stone tools: chop trees, break rocks and cut tall grass for twine
Campfires, recipes you find as you go, and a grid inventory
Camps: your lit campfire makes the land round it yours
Fishing with a spear at the pond, and cooking fish on a campfire
Drag items out of the Inventory, and on a computer loose items glow under the mouse
improved: New dark glass look with needs as rings, and nicer sticks, stones, berries and logs
